Substitute Type-1 Zoning Map Amendment

For 3233-47 N Sheffield Ave, Chicago, IL 60657
From B3-2 to a B2-5

1.A. The applicant seeks a zoning change from a B3-2 Community Shopping District
to that of a B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District to meet thebulk and density
standards of the B2-5 zoning district to allow the applicants to construct a new 5-

story residential building.
FAR 3.5
Density (MLA) 99 (284.29)
Building Area 97,480 sf
Lot Area 28,145 sf
Building Height 57-6”
Front Setback 0°
Rear Setback 24°
East Side Setback 0
West Side Setback 0”
Parking 25 Automobile and 50 Bicycle
ARO 15 on-site

e Per Section 17-13-1101-B: applicant is seeking a variation to reduce the rear
yard setback from 30 feet to 24 feet.

e Per Section 17-13-1003-GG: applicant is seeking an administrative
adjustment to reduce the number of minimum required bicycle parking
spaces to 50 spaces.

e Per Section 17-13-1003-ll: applicant is seeking administrative adjustments to
remove the required 439 sf interior landscaping area and the 4 required trees
in the rear parking area.

e Seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning
Code, for the attached plans.
